reviews.decision_reason: Coverage mapping preserves the exact supplied record identifiers and only marks exact capability-need matches as direct; the two non-matching needs remain unsupported with missing-safe empty capability identifiers.

The priorities output contradicts the declared behavior: direct-covered needs are marked unsupported=true and ranked before actually unsupported needs, while unsupported coverage rows are marked unsupported=false and pushed to the bottom. This reverses the required unsupported-before-covered ordering and makes the downstream recommendation depend on the wrong frontier.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank within each group

reviews.decision_reason: The unit retains the eight-item priority window and builds the recommendation from the first ranked priority record as declared. The recommendation is behaviorally contaminated by the upstream prioritization inversion, but no independent defect is visible in this boundary from the supplied semantic package.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record
independent market-demand support for the selected top need
